interface.shortDescription: Make, improve, and understand rolecards and software.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeaveX无限月读 1.9.0, with 22 skills for rolecards and Vibe Coding. Integrates card architecture, worldbook and variable design, character methods, researched frontend design and natural expression into the existing TW workflow. Standalone rolecard prompt rules retain the author’s intended strength and scope; malformed binding inventories return structured diagnostics. The existing installation identity and skill names remain unchanged. Windows component-export rollback preserves external replacements and reports remaining files. Host rediscovery and real SillyTavern acceptance still require verification in the user environment.
